title: T59 (Tinyana) PNC - Zariz VeNiskar / VeNifsad — Bechinah Bein HaMitzvos
author: Pettek Nanach

beginner.en: There is one who is zealous and gains, and one who is zealous and loses (Pesachim 50b). 'Mitzvah goreres mitzvah' (Avos 4) — one mitzvah drags another. There must be some bechinah between mitzvos that connects one mitzvah to its neighbor, by which they are dragged one after the other. And in truth this very bechinah — what is between the mitzvos — is itself extremely precious. Therefore one who is a tzaddik mi-ne'urav and walks the straight path from his days, going from level to level — like Avraham, 'and Avraham was old, ba ba-yamim' (Genesis 24:1), Avraham coming to his level through the days (Zohar Chayei Sarah 129a; ben shalosh shanim hikir es Bor'o, Nedarim 32a) — such a person, in this bechinah, loses through zealousness. When he is greatly zealous and runs ze-rizus from mitzvah to mitzvah, he forfeits the kedushah-bechinah between mitzvos: he passes over and skips it. The mitzvah itself is dragging him toward it through the previous mitzvah; if he too runs zealously into the mitzvah, he may skip and pass the in-between bechinah. He is zariz ve-nifsad. But when he tarries a little, he can in the meantime attain the bechinah bein ha-mitzvos. All this for one who walks be-darchei Hashem ke-seder mi-ne'urav. But a baal teshuvah must specifically be very, very zariz — to hasten and run, le-malet al nafsho — forbidden to tarry, to stand and settle. The baal teshuvah does not go from level to level at all; there is no bechinah-bein-ha-mitzvos between him and kedushah. He must begin anew, leap over what must be leapt over, and jump into kedushah be-zerizus gedolah. Such a person is zariz ve-niskar.

intermediate.en: **Yesh zariz ve-niskar, zariz ve-nifsad** (פסחים נ:). **"מצוה גוררת מצוה"** (אבות ד'). Ve-yesh **bechinah bein ha-mitzvos** — mah she-bein mitzvah le-mitzvah — she-mekasher mitzvah achas le-chavertah, asher al-yedei zeh ha-mitzvos nigrarim achas achar chavertah. U-ve-emes zos ha-bechinah atzmah **yekarah me'od.** Ve-al-ken: **mi she-tzaddik mi-ne'urav** ve-holech be-derech ha-yashar mi-yamav, **mi-darga le-darga** — "וְאַבְרָהָם זָקֵן בָּא בַּיָּמִים" (בר' כד:א), Avraham ba le-darga shelo al-yedei ha-yamim (זוה"ק חיי"ש קכט.; "בן שלש שנים הכיר את בוראו" נדרים לב.) — **ze, ba-bechinah zos, mafsid al-yedei zerizus**. Ki k'she-hu zariz gadol ve-rats bi-zerizus mi-mitzvah le-mitzvah, mafsid bechinas ha-kedushah she-bein mitzvah le-mitzvah, ki **al-yedei ha-zerizus over u-medaleg al ha-bechinah ha-zos** — ki ha-mitzvah atzmah holecheth elav (nigreres elav al-yedei ha-mitzvah ha-rishonah). U-ke-she-gam hu rats bi-zerizus el ha-mitzvah, az yuchal ledaleg u-la'avor et ha-bechinah ha-na"l — ve-al-ken hu **zariz ve-nifsad**. Aval **k'she-shoheh ketzas — yuchal be-soch kakh le-hasig gam ha-bechinah she-bein ha-mitzvos.** Ve-chol zeh le-mi she-holech be-darchei Hashem ke-seder mi-ne'urav. **Aval mi she-tzarich la'asos teshuvah — tzarich dika li-hyos zariz gadol me'od me'od, le-maher ve-laruts me'od le-malet al nafsho** — ve-asur lo li-shhos klal la'amod u-le-his-yashev — ki **baal-teshuvah eino holech mi-darga le-darga klal** ve-ein beino u-vein ha-kedushah shum bechinah. Ki tzarich le-haschil **me-chadash**, ve-tzarich laruts u-ledaleg el ha-kedushah, ke-mu-vah she-ha-baal-teshuvah tzarich ledaleg al mah she-tzarich ledaleg, ve-likpotz el ha-kedushah bi-zerizus gedolah. **Ish ka-zeh hu zariz ve-niskar.**

scholarly.he: [T2:59a] זריז ונשכר/ונפסד (פסחים נ:). "מצוה גוררת מצוה" (אבות ד). "ואברהם זקן בא בימים" (בר' כד:א); זוה"ק חיי"ש קכט.; נדרים לב.. צדיק מנעוריו — שוהה בין מצוות; בעל תשובה — קופץ ומדלג.

beginner.en: And the bechinah-bein-ha-mitzvos is, for example, 'va-yedaber Hashem el Moshe lemor — ve-asisa' (Exodus 25:1 and elsewhere). Surely there is avodah also in those words that come before the mitzvah itself. The essence of the mitzvah is stated in the Torah only afterward, after 'va-asisa.' But in truth there is avodah even in the verses that fall between mitzvah and mitzvah — and that is the bechinah being discussed: what stands between mitzvah and mitzvah. (See Likutey Moharan I:22 — there is avodah even in 'va-yedaber.')

intermediate.en: Ve-bechinah she-bein ha-mitzvos ha-na"l hi ke-gon: **"וַיְדַבֵּר ה' אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר... וְעָשִׂיתָ"** (שמ' כה:א ve-shar). U-ve-vadai **yesh avodah gam be-eilu ha-dibburim** she-hem kodem ha-mitzvah — ki ikar ha-mitzvah be-atzmah ne'emar ba-Torah achar-kakh, achar **תיבת "ועשית"**, **aval be-emes be-vadai gam ba-pesukim ha-na"l she-bein mitzvah le-mitzvah yesh ba-hem avodah**, ve-zehu **bechinah ha-na"l mah she-bein mitzvah le-mitzvah**. (לק"מ ח"א כב — yesh avodah gam be-pasuk "וידבר" וכו').

scholarly.he: [T2:59b] "וידבר ה' אל משה... ועשית" (שמ' כה:א ועוד) — אפילו בפתיחת המצוה יש עבודה. לק"מ ח"א כ"ב.
